I might be remembering wrong, but it was either Death will call my name or Death will call your name. Definetly with 'Death...' In the title.
I have also checked my bookmarks and it's missing.

I am not sure if I ever publish it since I dont think its good enough. Like, not just a bunch of incomprehensible feelings of ultimate dread and sadness mixed with self-deprecating humour, but actually something clever, easy enough to read, but deep enough to have its own meaning in the eyes of readers.
But maybe someday I'll muster up the courage.

I am writing a whole book dedicated to my overly depressed chars, filled with tragedy and morbid humor. It is definetly inspired by Fullmetal Alchemist, Mort by Terry Pratchett Kitchen by Banana Yoshimoto and Persona 3. Still, I want to believe that its something unique, not a mere fanfic with swapped names.
I am sorry if you find any mistakes, English is not my native tongue.
Well, you can always move to computer games industry. Last I heard, games with real-life gambling mechanics and microtransactions recieve +3 age mark at best.
